question.text: Number of points from where perpendicular tangents to the curve <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>25</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> can be drawn, is/are

solution.text: Director circle is the set of points from where drawn tangents are perpendicular, in this case <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> (equation of director circle) <math><mi>i.</mi><mi>e.</mi><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>9</mn></math> is not a real circle, so there is no point from where perpendicular tangents can be drawn.
